definitions.explanation: A state of mind that has lost its normal balance and reason; also, conduct so extreme it seems insane.

examples.japanese: {狂気|きょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{沙汰|さた}→沙汰：13446_sata⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an act of sheer madness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{狂気|きょうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧。
examples.english: A film depicting the madness of war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狂気|きょうき}じみた⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宿|やど}っていた→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧。
examples.english: There was a crazed gleam in his eyes.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {狂気|きょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{沙汰|さた}→沙汰：13446_sata⟧: a crazy thing to do; sheer madness
- {狂気|きょうき}じみた: crazed; bordering on insane
- {狂気|きょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into madness

- {正気|しょうき}: sanity — the direct antonym
- ⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧: abnormality — broader; not limited to the mind
